subject: general
question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Pliable
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e.** 'Rigid'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** "Pliable"** means flexible, capable of being bent, shaped, or adapted.(लचीला)
 
• It suggests that something or someone is flexible and can be manipulated without breaking.
 
• **Rigid **- It means stiff or unyielding; not pliant or flexible; hard.(कठोर)

Therefore, the **correct answer** is:** 'Rigid'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fluid - **This word is usually used to describe a substance that has no fixed shape and yields easily to external pressure; a gas or (especially) a liquid.(तरल)
 
• **Variable -** A variable is something that is likely to change or vary.(परिवर्तनशील).
 
• **Ductile -** It means capable of being shaped or bent or drawn out. (नम्य).
